fields.name: Alchemist's Supplies (50 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Intelligence. Utilize: Identify a substance (DC 15), or start a fire (DC 15). Craft: Acid, Alchemist's Fire, Component Pouch, Oil, Paper, Perfume

fields.name: Brewer's Supplies (20 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Intelligence. Utilize: Detect poisoned drink (DC 15), or identify alcohol (DC 10). Craft: Antitoxin

fields.name: Calligrapher's Supplies (10 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Dexterity. Utilize: Write text with impressive flourishes that guard against forgery (DC 15). Craft: Ink, *Spell Scroll*

fields.name: Carpenter's Tools (8 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Strength. Utilize: Seal or pry open a door or container (DC 20). Craft: Club, Greatclub, Quarterstaff, Barrel, Chest, Ladder, Pole, Portable Ram, Torch

fields.name: Cartographer's Tools (15 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Wisdom. Utilize: Draft a map of a small area (DC 15). Craft: Map

fields.name: Cobbler's Tools (5 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Dexterity. Utilize: Modify footwear to give Advantage on the wearer's next Dexterity (Acrobatics) check (DC 10). Craft: Climber's Kit

fields.name: Cook's Utensils (1 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Wisdom. Utilize: Improve food's flavor (DC 10), or detect spoiled or poisoned food (DC 15). Craft: Rations

fields.name: Glassblower's Tools (30 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Intelligence. Utilize: Discern what a glass object held in the past 24 hours (DC 15). Craft: Glass Bottle, Magnifying Glass, Spyglass, Vial

fields.name: Jeweler's Tools (25 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Intelligence. Utilize: Discern a gem's value (DC 15). Craft: Arcane Focus, Holy Symbol

fields.name: Leatherworker's Tools (5 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Dexterity. Utilize: Add a design to a leather item (DC 10). Craft: Sling, Whip, Hide Armor, Leather Armor, Studded Leather Armor, Backpack, Crossbow Bolt Case, Map or Scroll Case, Parchment, Pouch, Quiver, Waterskin

fields.name: Mason's Tools (10 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Strength. Utilize: Chisel a symbol or hole in stone (DC 10). Craft: Block and Tackle

fields.name: Painter's Supplies (10 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Wisdom. Utilize: Paint a recognizable image of something you've seen (DC 10). Craft: Druidic Focus, Holy Symbol

fields.name: Potter's Tools (10 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Intelligence. Utilize: Discern what a ceramic object held in the past 24 hours (DC 15). Craft: Jug, Lamp

fields.name: Smith's Tools (20 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Strength. Utilize: Pry open a door or container (DC 20). Craft: Any Melee weapon (except Club, Greatclub, Quarterstaff, and Whip), Medium armor (except Hide), Heavy armor, Ball Bearings, Bucket, Caltrops, Chain, Crowbar, Firearm Bullets, Grappling Hook, Iron Pot, Iron Spikes, Sling Bullets

fields.name: Tinker's Tools (50 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Dexterity. Utilize: Assemble a Tiny item composed of scrap, which falls apart in 1 minute (DC 20). Craft: Musket, Pistol, Bell, Bullseye Lantern, Flask, Hooded Lantern, Hunting Trap, Lock, Manacles, Mirror, Shovel, Signal Whistle, Tinderbox

fields.name: Weaver's Tools (1 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Dexterity. Utilize: Mend a tear in clothing (DC 10), or sew a Tiny design (DC 10). Craft: Padded Armor, Basket, Bedroll, Blanket, Fine Clothes, Net, Robe, Rope, Sack, String, Tent, Traveler's Clothes

fields.name: Woodcarver's Tools (1 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Dexterity. Utilize: Carve a pattern in wood (DC 10). Craft: Club, Greatclub, Quarterstaff, Ranged weapons (except Pistol, Musket, and Sling), Arcane Focus, Arrows, Bolts, Druidic Focus, Ink Pen, Needles

fields.name: Lifestyle - Wretched
fields.desc: You survive via chance and charity. You're often exposed to natural dangers as a result of sleeping outside.

fields.name: Lifestyle - Squalid
fields.desc: You spend the bare minimum for your necessities. You might be exposed to unhealthy conditions and opportunistic criminals.

fields.name: Lifestyle - Poor
fields.desc: You spend frugally for your necessities.

fields.name: Lifestyle - Modest
fields.desc: You support yourself at an average level.

fields.name: Lifestyle - Comfortable
fields.desc: You spend modestly for your necessities and enjoy a few luxuries.

fields.name: Lifestyle - Wealthy
fields.desc: You're accustomed to the finer things in life and might have servants.

fields.name: Lifestyle - Aristocratic
fields.desc: You pay for the best and might have a staff that supports your lifestyle. Others notice your wealth and might encourage you to share it, either legally or otherwise.
